description: This file defines an internal class 'GrainCountStatistics' that provides methods to retrieve activation count statistics for grains within the Orleans runtime, specifically focusing on per-grain-type metrics.

classes.name: GrainCountStatistics
classes.description: Provides statistics on per-grain-type activation counts within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of grain type names and their activation counts where the count is greater than zero.
